tabs.html:
MikroTik CRS326-24G-2S+RM – 24-Port Cloud Router Switch with 10G SFP+

High-Performance Layer 3 Switch for Enterprise & ISP Networks

The MikroTik CRS326-24G-2S+RM is a powerful Cloud Router Switch, designed for enterprise, ISP, and data center networks. It features 24 x Gigabit Ethernet ports and 2 x 10G SFP+ cages, ensuring high-speed connectivity, advanced VLAN support, and dual operating systems (RouterOS or SwitchOS) for ultimate flexibility.


With a 1U rackmount design, this switch is ideal for high-performance networking, offering seamless Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching capabilities for optimized traffic management and scalability.


Key Features 

  • High-Speed Networking – 24 x Gigabit Ethernet ports + 2 x 10G SFP+ cages for fast, stable connections.
  • Powerful Performance – 800 MHz CPU & 512MB RAM for smooth data processing.
  • Dual Boot OS – Choose between RouterOS L5 or SwitchOS for customized performance.
  • Enterprise-Grade Switching – Layer 2 & Layer 3 features, including VLAN, QoS, and traffic filtering.
  • 10G Fiber Uplinks – High-speed SFP+ ports for superior bandwidth and low latency.
  • Rackmount Ready – Compact 1U design for seamless integration into professional setups.
  • Energy-Efficient & Silent – Low power consumption with high efficiency.
  • Reliable MikroTik Quality – Manufactured by MikroTik, made in Latvia or China.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Guaranteed durability and long-term support.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CRS326-24G-2S+RM
  • CPU: 800 MHz
  • RAM: 512MB
  • Ethernet Ports: 24 x Gigabit LAN (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • SFP+ Ports: 2 x 10G SFP+ cages
  • Operating System: RouterOS L5 / SwitchOS (dual boot)
  • Switching Capacity: 52 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 77.37 Mpps
  • Rackmount Size: 1U standard 19-inch
  • Power Supply: PSU included
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia, China
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise & Business Networks – High-speed connectivity & network optimization.
  • ISP & Data Centers – Seamless traffic management with Layer 3 capabilities.
  • Fiber Uplink Solutions – Dual SFP+ cages for fast, stable 10G fiber connections.
  • Rackmount Network Deployments – Perfect fit for professional IT infrastructures.


Why Choose MikroTik CRS326-24G-2S+RM?

  • Cost-Effective & Powerful – Enterprise-grade networking at an affordable price.
  • Flexible Dual Boot OS – Choose between RouterOS and SwitchOS for custom configurations.
  • Advanced Layer 3 Switching – Supports VLAN, QoS, traffic filtering, and optimized routing.
  • Reliable & Scalable – Designed for long-term, high-performance networking.
